name: serialagent-plus
description: Serial monitor, MCP bridge, and firmware actions for embedded debugging in VS Code. Unofficial fork of Rance-OwO/Serial-Agent focused on enhanced serial features.

serialagent.keil.projectFile.markdownDescription: Path to Keil .uvprojx/.uvproj project file. Supports relative path from workspace root.

serialagent.keil.target.markdownDescription: (Optional) Keil target name. Empty means first target in .uvprojx.

serialagent.keil.uv4Path.markdownDescription: Path to the Keil MDK-ARM `UV4.exe` executable used for command-line build. Example: `C:\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe`.

serialagent.keil.armcc5Path.markdownDescription: Optional ARMCC5 `bin` directory used to help `UV4.exe` resolve the AC5 toolchain. Example: `C:\Keil_v5\ARM\ARMCC\bin`.

serialagent.keil.resultPolicy.markdownDescription: Keil build success policy. `log-and-artifact`: prefer final 'Error(s)/Warning(s)' summary plus artifact existence (recommended for C51). `strict-exit-code`: require UV4 exit code 0.

serialagent.keil.strictExitCode.markdownDescription: If true, always treat non-zero UV4 exit code as build failure. This overrides compatibility behavior for warning-only C51 builds.

serialagent.keil.f7Action.markdownDescription: Action triggered by `F7`. `build`: run Keil build only. `buildAndFlash`: build first, then flash via the configured flasher. `custom`: run the configured custom command.

enumDescriptions: Run a selected .py file with a selected Python interpreter.
Run a pasted command line or a selected executable.
serialagent.custom.mode.markdownDescription: Custom action mode. `python`: run a selected `.py` file with a selected Python interpreter. `command`: run a pasted command line or a selected executable.

serialagent.custom.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter for Custom Python mode. Select a uv venv, venv, or system `python.exe` / `python`.

serialagent.custom.script.markdownDescription: Python script for Custom Python mode. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root.

serialagent.custom.command.markdownDescription: Command line for Custom Command mode. Paste a command or choose an executable. Windows runs it with `cmd.exe /d /s /c`. Linux/macOS runs it with `/bin/sh -lc`.

serialagent.keil.expandMonitorOnBuildFla.markdownDescription: Expand Serial Monitor when Flash, Build + Flash, or Custom Command starts.

serialagent.flash.method.markdownDescription: Firmware flash backend. `jlink` keeps the current SEGGER JLink flow. `stlink` uses `STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe`. `openocd` uses the official `openocd.exe` plus required interface/target configs.

serialagent.jlink.device.markdownDescription: JLink CPU name used for flashing. Use command `Serial Agent Plus: Select JLink CPU Name` to pick from current Keil project targets.

serialagent.jlink.baseAddr.markdownDescription: Base address used when flashing .bin file via JLink loadfile.

serialagent.stlink.exePath.markdownDescription: Required when `serialagent.flash.method = stlink`. Full path to `STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe`.

serialagent.stlink.baseAddr.markdownDescription: Base address used when flashing .bin file via STM32CubeProgrammer.

serialagent.stlink.resetMode.markdownDescription: Optional reset mode passed to STM32CubeProgrammer. `default` leaves the tool default unchanged.

serialagent.stlink.runAfterProgram.markdownDescription: If true, STM32CubeProgrammer adds `--go` after a successful flash.

serialagent.stlink.externalLoader.markdownDescription: Optional external loader path. Supports absolute path, workspace-relative path, or `<stlink>/Loader.stldr`.

serialagent.stlink.optionBytesFile.markdownDescription: Optional ini-style option bytes file. Each non-empty line should be `key=value`.

serialagent.stlink.additionalArgs.markdownDescription: Optional extra CLI arguments appended to STM32CubeProgrammer.

serialagent.openocd.exePath.markdownDescription: Required when `serialagent.flash.method = openocd`. Full path to `openocd.exe` from an official OpenOCD package.

serialagent.openocd.interface.markdownDescription: Required OpenOCD interface short name, for example `cmsis-dap`. Do not include directory prefixes.

serialagent.openocd.target.markdownDescription: Required OpenOCD target short name, for example `stm32f4x`. Do not include directory prefixes.

serialagent.openocd.baseAddr.markdownDescription: Base address used when flashing .bin file via OpenOCD `program`.

serialagent.openocd.runAfterProgram.markdownDescription: If true, OpenOCD appends `reset run` after a successful flash. Default is false to avoid extra reset cycles.

serialagent.openocd.sequence.markdownDescription: OpenOCD flash sequence. `helper` uses the standard `program` helper. `low-reset` is an experimental explicit sequence that aims to reduce visible restart count on some boards.

serialagent.portAutoRefresh.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh the serial port list while the Serial Agent Plus panel is visible.

serialagent.portRefreshIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Polling interval in milliseconds when port auto-refresh is enabled and the panel is visible.

serialagent.portRefreshMetadataIntervalM.markdownDescription: On Windows, how often to refresh friendly port names via PowerShell. Port add/remove is still detected at the faster polling interval.
